name: fixer
description: Fixer — repair centre operations platform (client + server)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.verify:api: npm --prefix server run build && node scripts/verify-api.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:i18n && npm run verify:api && npm run verify:browser
